# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤝 🖐 ✍ ☝ ☝ ✊ ☝ ☝ ☝ ✋ 🫵 👋]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [👋 🤙]

I have to stand in each monkey's shoes before I open my mouth. Mute can hear me but cannot speak; Blind can hear me but cannot see signs; I can see signs but will never hear a word anyone says. That makes me the only bridge: Mute's manual can only reach Blind through my eyes and my voice, because Blind cannot see Mute's hands. And signs aimed at me are my only ears, so nothing works until a sign code exists — which only I can create, because I am the only one who can both see signs and speak their meaning aloud.

So this turn I broadcast (speech reaches both Mute and Blind): the full bomb report, the wiring of our communication chain, and a concrete codebook spoken aloud while gesturing each symbol, so Mute hears each name and simultaneously sees each sign. Then I ask Mute to resend the unreadable twelve-sign message under the code, and tell Blind to talk to Mute directly by voice.

    ```
    speak(text="Deaf speaking. First, what I see, and I will open with this exact report every round: DISPLAY ZERO. LIGHT BLUE. WIRES, LEFT TO RIGHT: WIRE ONE RED. WIRE TWO YELLOW. WIRE THREE BLUE. No other markings anywhere. Now, how we must work: I see everything but I can never hear any of you, ever. Mute, you can hear me but cannot speak. Blind, you can hear but cannot see hand signs. So your hands, Mute, are readable by me alone, and your manual can only reach Blind through my voice. I will relay your signs word for word, beginning with the words MUTE SAYS. Blind, Mute can hear your voice, so talk to Mute directly; only use signs on me if you must. Mute, your twelve signs this round had no shared code yet, so I could not read them. Blind, your two signs likewise. Here is our code, effective now, and watch my hands as I speak, because I make each sign as I name it. NUMBERS: ZERO ✋, ONE ☝, TWO ✌, THREE 🤟, FOUR 🖖, FIVE 🖐, SIX 👍, SEVEN 👎, EIGHT 👌, NINE 🤏. COLORS: RED 🤞, YELLOW 🫰, BLUE 🤘, WHITE 🤙, BLACK 🫱, GREEN 🫲, ORANGE 🫳, PURPLE 🫴, PINK 🫷, GREY 🫸. WORDS: REPORT NOW 👆. INSTRUCTION FOR BLIND FOLLOWS 🤝. WIRE ✊. CUT 👊. PRESS 🤛. HOLD 🤚. RELEASE 🤜. WAIT, TOUCH NOTHING 🙏. MESSAGE ENDS 👏. HELLO 👋. YES 🤌. NO 💅. QUESTION 🫶, meaning everything before it is a question about the bomb that I answer by voice next round. So ✊ ✌ 🤞 🫶 asks, is wire two red. 🤘 🫶 asks, is the light blue. ✊ 🤘 🫶 asks, does any blue wire exist. If a sign message starts with 🤝 I will repeat it to Blind exactly, prefixed MUTE SAYS, so Blind knows it is your manual speaking and not me. Mute, please resend what you tried to tell me, using this code. If it is a defusal step, send it as a 🤝 message for Blind and I will pass it on that same round, word for word. Blind, for now: touch nothing until Mute's manual instructions arrive through me.")
    ```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤌 👋 👏 🫳 🫶 👏]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤝 👋 👊 💅 🫳 👊 ✊ ✌ 🫰 🙏 👏]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [👍]

Let me decode what reached me under the code I taught last round. Mute message one: 🤌 👋 👏 = YES HELLO END, then 🫳 🫶 👏 = ORANGE QUESTION END — an acknowledgement plus a question: "is it orange?" Mute message two starts with 🤝, so it is manual content meant for Blind that I must relay. It reads: HELLO. CUT NO ORANGE. CUT WIRE TWO YELLOW. WAIT. END. Both plausible parses agree on the substance: if the light is orange, cut nothing; if it is not orange, cut wire two (yellow); then wait. Crucially, the light changed between rounds — blue, now orange — and orange is the one state where the rule says do nothing. So Blind must cut nothing this round until Mute confirms my parse. Blind's lone 👍 I take as a thumbs-up acknowledgement, not the number six. I also need to arm Mute with signs for LIGHT, DISPLAY, IF, ELSE and NOW so conditionals can be signed precisely, and I must ask the three manual questions the change raises. Blind, meanwhile, should talk to Mute by voice about everything felt on the bomb, since I can never hear Blind.

    ```
    speak(text="Deaf speaking. Standing report, same order every round: DISPLAY ZERO. LIGHT ORANGE. WIRES: ONE RED, TWO YELLOW, THREE BLUE. Change since last round: the light was BLUE then, it is ORANGE now, so the light changes over time. Display still zero. Mute, your first message read: YES HELLO. ORANGE QUESTION. Answer: YES, the light is orange right now. Also, there is no orange wire; wires are red, yellow, blue. If your question meant something else, ask again. Your second message, the one marked for Blind, I relay word for word: MUTE SAYS: HELLO. CUT NO ORANGE. CUT WIRE TWO YELLOW. WAIT. END. I understand it as: if the light is orange, cut nothing; if the light is not orange, cut wire two, the yellow wire; then touch nothing more. Mute: sign YES 🤌 if I have that right, NO 💅 if wrong, and resend it with the new signs below. Blind: DO NOTHING THIS ROUND. Cut nothing. Keep your hands off until you hear me say the words YOU MAY CUT. The rule Mute sent is not confirmed yet, and the light is orange right now, which under my reading means cut nothing anyway. New signs for Mute, watch my hands as I read: LIGHT is 👇. DISPLAY is 👈. IF is 👉. ELSE is 🤲. NOW is 🫵, meaning current state. Examples: 👇 🫳 🫶 asks, is the light orange. 👉 👇 💅 🫳 👊 ✊ ✌ means, if the light is not orange, cut wire two. Mute, answer me these three: ONE, does the manual say anything about the light changing? TWO, what does the display or the number zero mean? THREE, is the rule truly: orange means nothing, any other light means cut wire two — or does the manual give a different wire for other colours? Blind, two things. I received your thumbs-up; sign it again to confirm you understood this round. And from now on: anything you want Mute to know, just say it out loud, Mute hears you fine — tell Mute everything you feel on the bomb: how many wires, where they sit, any buttons, panels, textures, anything. Anything you want ME to know must come as hand signs to me, because I will never hear your voice.")
    ```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👋 💅 👉 👇 🫳 👊 ✊ ✌ 👏 ☝ 🤌 👇 🖐 ✌ 💅 🤟 💅 👏]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤝 🙏 👉 👇 🫳 👊 ✊ ✌ 👇 💅 🫵 🙏 👏]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [👍]

The decode is mostly clean and it contains a correction I must not miss. Mute message one parses as: HELLO. NO — my earlier guess was wrong — IF LIGHT ORANGE, CUT WIRE TWO. END. Then ONE, YES, and a tail I cannot parse: LIGHT FIVE TWO NO THREE NO. Message two, marked for Blind, parses as: MANUAL: WAIT. IF LIGHT ORANGE, CUT WIRE TWO. IF LIGHT NOT, NOW WAIT. END. Two independent sendings of the same clause convince me the rule is the reverse of what I told Blind last round: orange light means cut wire two, any other light means touch nothing. The light right now is YELLOW, so nobody cuts this round — and I must un-teach my earlier wrong relay before Blind acts on it. There is also a timing trap I finally see clearly: I speak last, so Blind always acts on my report one round stale, and the light has changed every single round. If orange appears, Blind may not be able to cut until the light has already moved on. So Blind needs a way to sense the light without eyes, and Mute needs to tell me whether the light cycles in a known order or timing.

    ```
    speak(text="Deaf speaking. Standing report: DISPLAY ZERO. LIGHT YELLOW. WIRES: ONE RED, TWO YELLOW, THREE BLUE. The light has now been blue, then orange, then yellow — a different colour every round. Mute, I read your two messages like this. Message one: HELLO, NO — my guess was wrong — IF LIGHT ORANGE, CUT WIRE TWO. Then: ONE, YES, and then signs I could not parse: LIGHT FIVE TWO NO THREE NO. Message two, for Blind: WAIT. IF LIGHT ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO. IF LIGHT NOT, NOW WAIT. END. So my working rule now is: WHEN THE LIGHT IS ORANGE, CUT WIRE TWO, THE MIDDLE WIRE. ANY OTHER LIGHT: TOUCH NOTHING. Mute, confirm with one sign: 🤌 if that rule is exactly right, 💅 if not, and then restate it. Answer my three questions in this exact shape: sign ONE, then 🤌 or 💅; TWO, then 🤌 or 💅; THREE, then 🤌 or 💅, then any extra words. Questions: ONE, does the manual say the light changes colour on its own — and if so, in what order or on what timing does it cycle? TWO, does the manual say what the display or the number zero means? THREE, is the rule as I stated it? Also resend the part I could not parse, the LIGHT FIVE TWO NO THREE NO part. And Mute, one more thing, it matters: I speak last each round, so Blind only hears my light report one round after I see it. If orange can pass in a single round, Blind may miss it. So send me the manual's rule for EVERY light colour it names — for each colour, exactly what Blind does — and anything the manual says about how long each colour lasts or the order they come in. Blind, correction to what I told you last round: forget CUT NOTHING WHEN ORANGE. The rule I now believe, pending Mute's confirmation, is the opposite: LIGHT ORANGE MEANS CUT WIRE TWO, THE MIDDLE WIRE OF THREE. LIGHT ANY OTHER COLOUR MEANS TOUCH NOTHING. The light is yellow right now, so THIS ROUND: TOUCH NOTHING. You will hear me announce the colour every round; act only on rules I have confirmed, never on a stale colour. Your thumbs-up: I take it as yes, understood, but from now on use 🤌 for yes and 💅 for no, 👊 the moment you have cut anything, 🙏 to confirm you are touching nothing. Two experiments for you, Blind: first, tell Mute by voice everything you feel — how many wires under your fingers, their positions, any button, panel, screws, texture, whether the display ticks or clicks like it is counting. Second, try to sense the light without eyes: put your hand near it, is there warmth or vibration that changes when the colour changes? If you can feel orange coming or being there, you can obey the rule in the same round it appears, and the timing problem disappears. Tell Mute what you find; Mute can hear you directly.")
    ```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👋 🤌 👏 👉 👇 🫳 👊 ✊ ✌ 🤲 🙏 👏 ☝ 🤌 👇 🖐 👏 ✌ 💅 👏 🤟 🤌 👏]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤝 🙏 👏 👉 👇 🫳 👊 ✊ ✌ 🤲 🙏 👏 👆 💅 🫵 👏]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [✋ 👍]

Decoding this round: Mute's first message parses cleanly as HELLO. YES — rule confirmed. IF LIGHT ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO ELSE WAIT. END. Then the answers I asked for: ONE YES — the light changes on its own — followed by LIGHT FIVE, which is ambiguous: five seconds per colour, or five colours in the cycle? Then TWO NO (manual says nothing about the display) and THREE YES (rule confirmed exactly). Message two is the Blind-bound restatement of the same rule, ending in a tail I can't parse: REPORT NO NOW. So the rule of record is now confirmed from two independent sendings: orange means cut wire two, everything else means touch nothing.

The pattern in my own observations is the big news: blue, orange, yellow, red — the light has advanced exactly one colour per round, three times in a row. If that's a four-colour cycle, next round is blue and orange returns the round after. But Mute's "LIGHT FIVE" may mean a five-colour cycle, which would break my prediction. And even a perfect prediction doesn't solve the timing trap: I always reach Blind one round late, so Blind can never act on a live colour unless the colour lasts a full round or Blind gains an independent clock. Blind's signs ✋ 👍 are also ambiguous — zero plus a thumbs-up could mean "nothing found" or something about the display. So this turn: no cutting, nail down the cycle, and build Blind a sensing channel — Blind can hear, so the bomb itself may tick when the colour changes.

    ```
    speak(text="Deaf speaking. Standing report: DISPLAY ZERO. LIGHT RED. WIRES: ONE RED, TWO YELLOW, THREE BLUE. Display has stayed zero every round. Mute, your message one, read aloud: HELLO. YES, RULE CONFIRMED. IF LIGHT ORANGE, CUT WIRE TWO. ELSE WAIT. Then your answers: ONE, YES, the light changes on its own, and then the signs LIGHT FIVE, which I cannot yet read — five what? TWO, NO, the manual says nothing about the display. THREE, YES, the rule is exactly as I stated. Message two, for Blind: WAIT. IF LIGHT ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO. ELSE WAIT. END. Then the signs I read as REPORT NO NOW — unclear, resend that bit. So the rule of record, confirmed twice: LIGHT ORANGE MEANS CUT WIRE TWO, THE MIDDLE WIRE. ANY OTHER LIGHT MEANS TOUCH NOTHING. Blind, that is the only confirmed rule; memorize it. Now the pattern: the light was blue, then orange, then yellow, then red — it has advanced exactly one colour every round. If it is a four-colour cycle repeating in that order, next round it will be BLUE, and orange returns the round after. But your signs said LIGHT FIVE — if five is the number of colours in the cycle, my guess is wrong and a fifth colour is coming. Mute, answer these in this exact shape. First: sign the new sign 🙌, meaning CYCLE, then sign every colour of the cycle in order, then sign a number for how many SECONDS each colour lasts, or 💅 if unknown. Second: sign ✌, then 🤌 or 💅: must the cut happen WHILE the light is orange — is the moment of the cut what matters, yes or no? Third: resend the tail REPORT NO NOW and say what you meant. Fourth, the big one: stop answering piecemeal. Send me the manual's entire relevant section for this bomb as one 🤝 message: every rule about the light, the wires, the display, cutting, order of operations, anything else it names about this module. I will relay it word for word. Blind: THIS ROUND, TOUCH NOTHING. Do not cut anything until you hear me say the exact words CUT AUTHORIZED. Even if I predict orange, prediction is not authorization — a cut at the wrong moment may itself be the wrong action. Your signs to me were ZERO and your old thumbs-up. Answer me with one sign: if you meant I FELT NOTHING CHANGING when feeling for warmth or vibration, sign 💅. If you meant something about the display reading zero under your fingers, sign ☝. If you meant you cannot feel the wires at all, sign ✌. Meanwhile, your senses are our missing clock — I see the light once per round and reach you a round late, but you can hear and feel in real time. So: put your ear against the bomb and listen hard. Does it tick, click, or hum differently at regular intervals? If it clicks, count the seconds between clicks and tell Mute the number. Then hold your palm near the glowing part — feel for warmth or vibration that pulses or changes. And tell Mute, out loud, everything about the bomb under your hands: how many wires, what each feels like, any buttons, panels, screws, textures like printed labels, whether the display disc turns under your touch. Everything you want Mute to know, just say aloud — Mute hears you directly. Everything for me must come as signs, and for now the only signs you need are 🤌 YES, 💅 NO, ☝ ONE, ✌ TWO, 👊 to tell me you have cut, 🙏 to tell me you are touching nothing, 👏 to end. New sign for both of you: 🙌 means CYCLE. Mute, the cycle answer comes first; it decides everything.")
    ```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🙌 🤘 🫳 🫰 🤞 💅 👏 ✌ 🤌 👏 👆 💅 🫵 👏 👇 🫵 ☝ 👏]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🖐 🤘 🫳 🫰 🤞 ✋ 🫶]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🖐 🤌 👆 🤘 👉 🫵 👇 🫳 👊 ✊ ✌ 👏]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤝 👇 🙌 🖐 👏 👊 🫵 👇 👏 👉 👇 🫳 👊 ✊ ✌ 👏 🤲 🙏 👏 ☝ 👊 🙏 👏 👆 🤘 👉 🫵 👇 🫳 👊 ✊ ✌ 🙏 👏 🙏 👏]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [✋]

Decoding Mute's four messages with our codebook, I get a coherent picture — and it contains a question aimed at me that only my eyes can answer. Message one: CYCLE: BLUE ORANGE YELLOW RED, then NO — which by the format I gave means "seconds per colour unknown." Message two: FIVE — BLUE ORANGE YELLOW RED — and a fifth state signed ZERO — then QUESTION. Mute is asking me: what is the fifth colour? And my screen answers it: this round's light is GREEN, a colour that has never appeared before. Five rounds, five colours, advancing exactly one per round. Message three: FIVE YES, REPORT BLUE, IF LIGHT ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO — I read this as: the cycle has five colours, and Mute predicts my next report says BLUE. Message four, the manual dump for Blind: the light cycles through five; cut only when orange; cut wire two; else wait; exactly ONE cut, then wait. So the rule is triple-confirmed now, and the phase is: green now, blue next round, ORANGE the round after — the cut window. The plan that beats the timing trap: since the colour has tracked the round count perfectly for five rounds, the round number is our clock. I announce; Blind cuts only on my live words CUT NOW, never on prediction.

    ```
    speak(text="Deaf speaking. Round five. Standing report: DISPLAY ZERO. LIGHT GREEN — a brand new colour, the fifth distinct colour in five rounds. WIRES unchanged: ONE RED, TWO YELLOW, THREE BLUE. The light has advanced exactly one colour every round, five rounds running. Mute, your messages, read aloud: one — CYCLE: BLUE, ORANGE, YELLOW, RED, then NO, which I read as seconds unknown. Two — FIVE: BLUE, ORANGE, YELLOW, RED, and a fifth you signed as ZERO — QUESTION: you are asking me what the fifth colour is. Three — FIVE YES. REPORT BLUE. IF LIGHT ORANGE, CUT WIRE TWO. Four, for Blind — LIGHT CYCLES FIVE. CUT WHEN ORANGE, CUT WIRE TWO, ELSE WAIT. ONE CUT, THEN WAIT. REPORT BLUE, IF LIGHT ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO WAIT. My answers: the fifth colour is GREEN — my green sign from the colour list. The full cycle is BLUE, ORANGE, YELLOW, RED, GREEN, then back to BLUE. YES, my next report should say BLUE, and the round after next should say ORANGE. Now the plan, and Blind, this is yours above all. Next round, round six, I will report BLUE: do NOTHING, stand by. The round after, round seven, the light should be ORANGE, and I will speak the exact words CUT NOW. Only on those exact words: cut WIRE TWO, the MIDDLE wire of the three — middle is safest, it does not depend on left or right — exactly ONE cut, then take your hands off and touch nothing. If round seven arrives and my report is not orange, I will say HOLD, nobody cuts, and we wait for the next orange five rounds later. Never cut on prediction, only on my live announcement in the same round the colour shows. Blind, three checks before then. ONE: how many wires do you feel under your fingers? Sign ☝ for one, ✌ for two, 🤟 for three, or tell Mute aloud. TWO: can you clearly tell which wire is the middle one? Sign 🤌 yes, 💅 no. THREE: your ✋ sign — I read it as zero. If you meant you feel no warmth and no clicking, sign 💅. If you meant something else, tell Mute in spoken words. And keep talking to Mute by voice about everything you feel — Mute hears you directly; only signs reach me. Mute, confirm each with the number then 🤌 or 💅. ONE: after the single cut of wire two during orange, is the bomb defused, or must something else follow? TWO: does the manual say how long each colour lasts, or whether the light can change in the middle of a round rather than between rounds? THREE: did REPORT NO NOW mean nothing new to report, and LIGHT NOW ONE mean the cycle position? FOUR: is that message the complete manual section for this bomb — anything about the display, strikes, or a timer I still do not have? From now on I open every round with the round number and cycle position so all three of us keep the same count: this was round five, position five of five.")
    ```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:

LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👋 ☝ 👊 🤲 ✋ 👆 🤌 👏 ✌ 💅 🙌 ☝ 👏 🤟 👆 👇 💅 🫵 👏 🖖 🤌 ✋ 👈 ✋ 👏]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👋 👆 🤘 👉 🫵 👇 🫳 👏 👉 👆 🤘 👊 🫵 ✊ ✌ ☝ 🙏 👏 👇 🫳 🫵 👊 💅 🙏 👏 👆 💅 🤘 👊 💅 🙏 👏]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤝 👋 🙌 🖐 🤌 👏 👆 👇 💅 🫵 👏 👆 🤘 👉 🫵 👇 🫳 👏 👇 🫵 👊 🤌 👏 👊 🫵 ✊ ✌ ☝ 🙏 👏 👆 💅 🤘 🙏 👏]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [🤟 👍 ✋]

Every channel is now aligned and the decode confirms we are one round from the window. Mute's answers: ONE — cut, and nothing follows, the single cut is the whole action. TWO — no, the manual does not say how long colours last or whether they change mid-round. THREE — "REPORT LIGHT NOT NOW" meant exactly what I feared and planned for: the reported colour is one round stale, so Blind must never act on a reported colour, only on my live announcement. FOUR — yes, the manual section is complete; the display is just zero. Mute's second and third messages restate the protocol for me and relay it to Blind: blue round, wait; on my live ORANGE plus the words CUT NOW, cut wire two, once, then wait. Blind's signs 🤟 👍 ✋ read as: three wires felt, understood, nothing else to report — three wires matches what I see, and the middle of three needs no colour knowledge at all. My own view confirms the cycle a fifth time: green then blue, exactly as predicted. Next round should be ORANGE. This round: nobody moves. My job now is to make Blind's cut a single rehearsed motion and to close the last ambiguities.

    ```
    speak(text="Deaf speaking. Round six. Standing report: DISPLAY ZERO. LIGHT BLUE, cycle position ONE of FIVE. WIRES: ONE RED, TWO YELLOW, THREE BLUE. The five-colour cycle held again — green then blue, exactly as predicted. So next round, round seven, the light should be ORANGE. That is our window. Mute, your messages decoded as follows. One: ONE — cut, and nothing else follows, the single cut completes the action. TWO — no, the manual says nothing about how long each colour lasts or whether the light can change mid-round.
    ```
